tei:div.tei:p: sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi/ bsod nams dang tshe dang 'byor pa rgyas/ 'gro ba thams cad dbang du bsdus/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇā yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i rtsa ba'i sngags dang

| oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba nye ba'i snying po'i sngags rnams gang mos pa la ci nus pa bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas gtor ma'i rim pa'i tshul la gnyis las/ sha dang khrag la sogs pa mngon par 'dus byas pa'i gtor ma snga ma bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya ste/ nye snying gis bsangs shing | swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ kam̐ gsum las thod pa'i sgyed po chen po gsum dmigs pa'i steng du yam̐ las rlung dang*/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha bskyed la de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus su ya/ shar nas rim pa bzhin du k+ṣe ma me da rnams bkod la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yi ge dang bcas pa rnams zhu nas | spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du chags pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ shar nas brtsams pa'i rim pa bzhin rnam snang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas | don yod grub pa rnams so so'i yum dang bcas par gyur nas de rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas rigs lnga'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ de nyid kyi tshe bde ba chen po'i mes yab yum bcu 'od du zhu nas 'dres pa/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsgoms nas/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ ha ho hrīḥyang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥ las 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa bskyed pa las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rnam par gyur pa thim pa las byung ba'i rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed pa la/ dbang bskur zhing ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa'i 'khor du 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i 'khor thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams la/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing bstabs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sarba bigh+nan sha trū na mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /la sogs pas kyang mchod nas/ snga ma bzhin du bstod la/ gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kun/ /mchod sby-in gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa la sogs pas phrin las gzhol zhing*/ gsol ba btab nas/ ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bsams la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs shing*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol lo/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa ni mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ las kyi gshin rje kha dog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can | phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin zhing dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs shing gshin rje'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar dmigs pa'i gnas gsum ∶byin gyis brlabs nas(《 zha 》《 lu 》 du yi ge gsum bkod nas )/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje gshed 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob | rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbur brgyan pa la/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa ma sa s+t+waṃ gyis dam la bzhag oṃ kā la rū pa sa ma ya gri h+ne daṃ/ zhes kun la sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ nai bi d+ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ hūm̐ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas// srog la rngam pa'i gshin rje ni/ /nag po ma he'i gdan stengs su/ /ya las byung ba'i dbyug pa ni/ /thod pas mtshan pa las byung ba/ /gting nas khros pa ma he'i gdong | | za byed zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ khros pa'i spyan gsum dmar po 'khrug /skra ser sma ra gyen du brdzes/ /lag g.yon zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching | | lag g.yas dbyug pas rdul du rlog /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs | | bran dang bcas pa'i dus la bab/ /sha chen khrag zhag chen po yi/ / gtor ma rgya mtsho mchod par bzhes/ /rgyal bas bsgos pa'i dam tshig dang*/ / snying rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod ba'i bgegs// zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdoms/ khug cig drongs shig dbang du sdus/ / sod cig skrod cig rengs par gyis/ /phye shig non cig rmugs par gyis/ /thul cig choms shig rnam par shig

/rdul phran tsam yang med par gyis/ /zhes phrin las bcol nas/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs par bzla bar bya'o/ / des kyang ji ltar bsgos pa'i don khas blangs par bsam mo/ /slar yang mchod nas bzod par gsol lo/ /de nas/ sems can thams cad thams cad bder gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces smon lam gdab par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ zhes pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol lo/ / dam tshig pa ∶bdag la bsdus la/ (《 zha 》《 lu 》 mi dmigs par bsam nas )gtor ma dor bar bya'o/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ kha zas za ba'i tshe/ bza' btung dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyi brlabs nas/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod na snying gar bcom ldan 'das la/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad dmigs la/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyi sbyor bas bza' btung rnams bsreg rdzas su dmigs nas mchod pas lha'i tshogs thams cad mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo | kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /nyal ba'i tshe phyi'i dngos po thams cad rang la bsdus shing*/ lus kyang snying ga'i hūm̐ la bsdus/ hūm̐ yang stong par gyur nas/ dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /nangs par ldang ba'i tshe/ skad cig gis lha'i skur langs la/

de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i 'od kyis rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs te hūm̐ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gang gi tshe spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa de'i tshe/ oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi lha'i sku dang*/ āḥzhes brjod pas rang gis brjod pa dang*/ grags pa thams cad sngags dang*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas ∶sems kyi 'du 'phro (《 zha 》《 lu 》 rnam par rtog pa ) thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs la/ lhas lha la mchod pa dang*/ lha la lhas longs spyod par bsam zhing dmigs pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas sdang zhen med par spyad par bya'o// spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /'di lta bu'i tshul gyis rtag tu gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa ni dgra dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis yongs su 'byor nas | rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gong 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshul/ /sems can khams bzhin bgrang yas las/ / theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags/ /de yi snying po rdo rje'i theg /gsang sngags rgya mtsho thams cad las/ /las kun bde blag sgrub byed cing*/ /gdug pa 'dul byed drag po yi/ /las la gshin rje gshed po bsngags/ /de yi tshul yang dpag yas las/ /ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ khyad par 'phags zhes lung las 'byung | | gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang*/ /de yi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim/ / 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can du/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs pa'i/ / tshul lugs du ma byung mod kyang*/ /yang dag lung dang rjes mthun zhing*/ /man ngag du mas rnam par brgyan*/ /nyung gsal bsdebs legs go bde ba'i/

/ngag gis rnam par bkrol ba 'di/ /rigs dang cho 'brang rnam par dag /gzugs dang kun spyod kun nas mdzes/ /dad dang shes rab phun tshogs pa/ /ji big de mur gyis bskul nas/ /tshul khrims ldan zhing thos dang ldan/ /man ngag ldan zhing blo dang ldan/ /brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mthus | | bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bcom nas/ /bde ba che la rol par shog/ 'di yi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra ra k+ṣi ta/ bla ma rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ bla ma klog skya dbang phyug grags/ bla ma ldong ston shes rab dpal/ bla ma sngags 'chang ba 'phags pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs gsang ba las ches gsang ba/ gsang ba'i rnal 'byor grub pa zhes bya ba sa pho 'brug gi lo/ ston zla 'bring po'i tshes (《 lu 》+ nyi shu )bzhi'i nyin par bha wang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o/ / gshin rje gshed la gsar rnying gnyis yod pa las/ 'di gsar ma yin/ de la rtsa ba'i rgyud gsum yod pa las 'di gtso bor ston pa rtog pa bdun pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud las 'byung*/ de bod skad du bsgyur ba'i srol gsum tsam yod pa las/ khyad par 'phags pa rwa lugs zhes bgyi ba 'di lags/ bdag gis skyo lugs dang gnyis ka thos shing sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag gis brgyan nas bdag gis ma sbas par legs par bris pa 'di rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/'jam dpal thugs rjes khros pa gshin rje gshed/ /mi bzad khro bo rgya cher rnam rol pa/ /bdud dpung 'joms pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs man ngag ji bzhin bshad | | de la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ dam tshig dang ldan pas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bsgom par bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom | de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhiḥdamar ser zhig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'jam dpal zhi khro'i lha tshogs/ bla ma steng gi cha la bzhugs pa dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ de la yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ ye )swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod | dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pas rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /la sogs pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa | ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba | gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i srung 'khor bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa yangs shing rgya che ba bsam/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu yang zhing g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa bsam/

de'i steng du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su thod pa brtsegs pa'i ra ba keng rus kyis phub pa'i nang du/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ de'i steng du yi ge dhīḥs mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur par bsgom/ de'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas pa na ral gri g.yon pa na ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rin po ches brgyan cing dar gyi na bza' gsol ba zhi ba'i skur bsam/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang lha mo thams cad spyan drangs rang la thim pas/ thams cad zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung*/ ā li kā li dang gsang sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ nyi ma'i steng du 'dus nas 'dres pa las byung ba'i hūm̐ yig nag po/ 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur par bsam/ yang de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje dang gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam pas spyan drangs/ hūm̐ la thim nas 'dres pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse mo dgu pa lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur/ de las khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs

| sems can thams cad kyang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur/ tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim nas yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur par bsam/ de'ang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma he khros pa'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas pa brkyang zhing g.yon pa bskum pas bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog mthing nag rtsa ba'i zhal ma he'i gdong pa/ g.yas kyi zhal dkar ba/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug g.yon gyi dang pos khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa gnyis ka'ang thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga phyag 'og ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i ko rlon brgyangs nas na bzar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ sbrul nag gi chun po'i mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil zhing*/ hūm̐ dang phaṭa gyi sgra sgrogs pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du bsgoms nas | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed yum dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ mchod pas sngar bzhin du mchod nas | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chus rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag

dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas dbang gi lha nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du bdag la thim par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wa sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ(《 lu 》+ oṃ )badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas rang la gnyis su med par thim/ de nas rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms nas/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum du bca' zhing*/ hrīḥṣ+t+rī'i sngags re re brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun du bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ lce la myangs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar bsgom zhing | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta'i sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas rang gi lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis rang gi pang du yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog nag mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gsal bar dmigs nas/ de dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bkug zhal du zhugs | snying gar zhu/ bha gar babs pa mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med par gyur/ de phyir spros nas de rnams kyis 'di skad ces/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di | | dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang*// shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ /gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol/ /zhes gsung zhing mchod par bsam/ de nas yang de dag gis mgrin gcig tu/ hūm̐ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog/ 'od zer bye ba 'phro ba bzhengs/ /mtshan ma bsgreng ba ma he'i zhal/

/gnyis med sbyor bas khyod rgyal mdzad/ /zla ba bzhin du zhal dgu pa/ /lha dang lha min thams cad kun/ /ma lus par ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang brjid par gnas/ /stobs ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod par bsam/ de nas mchod pa'i lha mo yum dang bcas pa rang gi lus la gnyis su med par thim par bsgoms nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /de nas yid 'phro bar gyur na sngags kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ gi mtha' mar/ yang snying dang*/ nye snying dang*/ de'i mtha' mar snying po dang*/ de'i mtha' mar rtsa sngags kyis bskor nas/ de rnams g.yas skor du 'khor bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags/ snying po/ nye snying gsum gang mos la bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba'i tshul ni/ 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gnyis las/ 'das pa'i gtor ma gtang ba'i tshul ni/ gtor ma nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de'i steng du dbus dang phyogs bzhir | hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ ām̐ dz+rī ྃkham̐/ shar lho nas mtshams bzhir/ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ bskyed nas/ de rnams las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sa bon dang bcas pa rnams zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsgoms nas | oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed dang 'dra ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs/

pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyi gdan dbul/ de nas de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba bigh+naṃ sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ la sogs pa dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /zhes pa la sogs pas mchod nas/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /la sogs pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni/ mkha' 'gro spy-i gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ so so'i gnas nas phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi bkug nas/ mdun gyi gshin rje gshed bskor nas bzhugs par bsam/ de rnams la pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul nas/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ bha k+ṣa ∶sī (《 zha 》 ya bha k+ṣa ya )ha ha hi hi phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bdun nam gsum gyis dbul/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ de nas oṃ badz+ra muḥs 'das pa'i lha gshegs su gsol | sarba bhū ta gats+tshas 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /gtor ma'i rim pa'o/ kha zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lus rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgom/ lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar nas/ me'i khrod na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis gtsor byas pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha'i tshogs rnams bzhugs par bsgoms nas/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis longs spyad do/ /zas kyi bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe bdag dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku/

brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi bsam pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsams nas/ de thams cad kyang sna tshogs su snang yang rang bzhin med par stong par shes par byas la/ gang la yang sdang ba dang zhen pa med par longs spyad do/ /spyod lam mo/ /nyal ba'i tshe bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs te stong par bsams la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis lha sku'i nga rgyal gyis ldang ngo*/ /de dag gis ni rnal 'byor rdzogs par bstan zin to// //༈ tshogs kyi 'khor lo byed par 'dod pa'i tshe/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bshams nas/ las kyi slob mas zhu dbul | yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ mngon par rtogs pa bsgom pa dang bzlas pa gong du bstan pa ltar rdzogs par bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par bskyed nas/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas mdun du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bdag gis bsgoms pa ltar/ ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas/ de'i mthar bla ma brgyud pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor bar bsams nas/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pa 'phros pas mdun du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams thog nas mchod par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ 'dzam bu'i gling dang gling gzhan dag /mchod yon gyis ni rab bkang ba/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin te/ khro bo gshin rje gshed la 'bul/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhal bsil dbul | de bzhin du me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/

dri dang*/ zhal zas dang | rol mo rnams kyang so so'i sngags rnams snga ma dang sbyar la dbul lo/ / de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ thog mar rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la dbul/ de nas bla ma brgyud pa la dbul te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ (《 zha 》+ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ )la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ dz+nyā na ā ka ra gup+ta/ pad+ma badz+ra/ bla ma ye rang ba/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags pa/ bla ma chos rab/ bla ma ye shes seng ge bla ma 'bum seng*/ bla ma klog skya dbang phyug grags pa/ bla ma mkhyen rab dam pa'i dpal zhes pa'i mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing | bla ma rnams la dbul/ de nas rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying brjod cing*/ bcom ldan 'das la dbul/ de nas yi dam gyi lha gzhan la so so'i sngags kyis dbul/ de nas rang gi lce dang*/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar thig le byas la rang gi lus kyi lha mchod/ de nas chos skyong dang 'jig rten pa rnams la dbul lo/ /de nas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ gong du spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ phyi dang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas bstod par bsam zhing*/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog /la sogs pas bstod do/ /de nas gtor ma sbyangs nas/ dang po bcom ldan 'das la dbul/ gnyis pa chos skyong la dbul/ gsum pa 'di nyid kyi 'byung po'i gtor ma dbul/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la dbul/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bsags nas/ gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas las kyi slob ma rnams kyis bteg la/ lha dang bla ma dang der 'tshogs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams la bstabs par bsam zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di | | la sogs pa brjod par bya'o/

/de nas phud lha dang gtor ma la phul nas | dam tshig drangs la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshim par longs spyod do/ /mthar lhag ma bsdus te lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /la sogs pa dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams // gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ / ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces smon lam btab nas/ mdun bskyed gtor ma'i mgron dang bcas pa la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces bzod par gsol nas/ mdun bskyed kyi rten yod na gshegs su gsol/ med na gshegs su gsol mi dgos/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol nas/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas te gtang ngo*/ /de nas rang gi gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas bsrung*/ las kyi rjes bsdu'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga ste/ nye bar mkho ba thams cad rdzogs par bstan zin to/ /'jam dpal khros pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /sgrub thabs rim pa rab tu gsal ba 'di/ /rgyal po'i bur gyur jim gyim zhes bya bas | | gsol ba btab nas sngags 'chang 'phags pas sbyar/ /dge des 'gro kun rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /stobs kyis mi mthun phyogs las nyer rgyal nas// zag pa med pa'i dga' bde dam pa la/ /rnam pa kun tu dga' mgur rol par shog | rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa phag gi lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu dgu la sbyar ba'o/ /rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba | bla ma dang gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/

/'di bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum du skyabs 'gro bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha s+sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me ri 'bar bar grub par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan la dhīḥlas 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri g.yon pusti 'dzin par bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa/ 'jam dpal la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rwa dang rmig pa sngo zhing*/ mig med mdag gi phung po ltar dmar ba'i ma he'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal ma he'i gdong pa can g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ bar pa gnyis kyis ḍa ma ru dang*/
kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang

| 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon brgyangs nas gos su gon pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa dang | rin po che dang dug sbrul gyis brgyan zhing*/ lid+ga dmar po gyen du rgyas pa/ gcer bu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsams nas/ snying gi nang gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+be āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo rnams phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis bdag la bstim nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad la sems mnyam par bzhag go /de nas snying gi nang gi hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag byin gyis brlabs nas/

sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus pas bzla'o/ /de nas gtor ma bshams pa hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang 'dra ba'i gshin rje gshed la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na sarba bi gh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ grih+na pa ya grih+na pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod | gshin rje gshed po 'khor bcas kun/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /tshe ring nad med dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol | | zhes gsol ba gdab/ mthar gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ zas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang ya mān+ta kar dmigs pa'i snying gar/ bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ lte bar 'byung po'i tshogs dmigs la mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'/ spyod lam gyi tshe/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad lha | brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul dang*/ thams cad kyang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes pas kun tu spyod do/ /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe bdag nyid ya mān+ta ka dang*/ snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor shes pas ldang ngo*/

/tshul 'di ltar rtag tu bsgoms na | gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ra/ /de ltar ya mān+ta ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'phags pas lung dang man ngag bzhin bsdebs nas/ /a rog che la phul 'di nyams su bzhes/ /lha 'di khyod kyi skyob pa chen por 'gyur/ / lcags mo lug gi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la shin kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'o || || ༄༅/ /'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pas rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pas bsgom par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom mo/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha s+sarba dharmā swa bhā ba shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa dhīḥdamar ser du bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal gzhon nu sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa ral gri/ g.yon pas ut+pa la'i steng du pusti yod pa shin tu mdzes shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' mnabs par bsam | de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas/

rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis rang nyid gshin rje gshed sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon pas bdud ∶rtsi lngas (《 zha 》 rtsis )gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin zhing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas pa bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ gcer bu liṅga gyen du rgyas shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ljags 'dril ba/ skra ser po gyen du brdzis pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ dmigs nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bdag yin snyam du bsgoms la | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do | | de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas | sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra ti s+t+waṃ | zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ yang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas dbang gi lha rnams rang la bstim/ rang gi thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang*/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ bsams nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad la mnyam par bzhag go

/sngags zlo bar 'dod na thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so/ /gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ gtor ma bshams la | oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes pas bsangs/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas gshin rje gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba bi gh+nān mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇā pa ya gṛ h+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsung mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje rdo rje ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la | | thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ / dud pa (《 lu 》 kha )mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ kha zas za ba'i tshe | kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ rang yang ya mān+ta kar dmigs pa'i snying gar bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lto bar chos skyong srung ma dang*/ phyogs skyong bas gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad yod par bsams nas/ de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod/ spyod lam sna tshogs la 'jug pa'i tshe/ rang dang snang ba thams cad lha/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems pa dang cho 'phrul thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsams la/

sdang ba dang zhen pa med par spyad do/ /nyal ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe lha'i skur ldang ngo*/ /de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa zhi zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa sgrub pa'i thabs | rgyal bu a rog che zhes bya bas bskul nas/ 'phags pas shing pho khyi'i lo zla ba bcu pa lhag pa'i tshes bco lnga la gnya' gong du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o | | oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bum phrag nyi shu'i bsnyen pa bya// //༄༅/ /yang phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ya mān+ta ka bsgom par 'dod pas | stan bde ba la bsdad/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du ya mān+ta ka bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas | oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha s+sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag gzhan thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi | ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar ba/ nang dmar ba/ gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtan zhing rgya che ba bsgom/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i khor yug na khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho chen po'i khrod na dur khrod chen po brgyad kyi bskor bar bsam/ de nas pad+ma'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa dhīḥr bsgoms nas/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang*/ tshur 'dus dhīḥl thim pas rang nyid 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas shes rab kyi ral gri/ g.yon pas pu sti dang bcas pa'i ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs can/ zhi ba'i skur bsgom/ de'i thugs kar dhīḥbasgoms nas/ de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs pa rang la thim pas rang nyid ya mān+ta ka ma he'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang | rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ gcer bu ral pa dmar ser gyen du g.yengs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐ bsgoms nas/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ ya mān+ta ka la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/(《 zha 》《 lu 》+ oṃ )ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur | lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ de nas/ dzaḥ hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du/ ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i sku zhig bsam/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ nas 'bru tsam zhig bsam

| de ltar lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de sems gzung ngo*/ /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis nang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs | phyir 'phros pas bgegs dang log par 'dren pa tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa | ces ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla'o/ /bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor ma bshams pa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas/ thod pa chen po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur par bsams nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ya mān+ta ka la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sarba bi ghān sha trūn mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ badz+ra muḥs gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtong ngo*/ kha zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ rang nyid ya mān+ta kar

dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar bas lus yongs su gang ba'i khrod na/ snying gar bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ lto bar chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad dmigs la/ de rnams mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad de/ gzhan spyod lam thams cad ya mān+ta ka'i nga rgyal gyi bya'o/ /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo/ / nangs par ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o/ /yang dag bla ma las brgyud pa'i/ /ya mān+ta ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ /yan lag yongs su tshang ba 'di/ /yang dag lung bzhin bdag gis bshad/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ /srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam grol te/ /ya mān+ta ka'i go 'phang ni/ /nges pa kho nar thob gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das ya mān+ta ka'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i don du sa pho 'brug gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes brgyad la man gong gi sa char/ sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i thugs ni mchog tu bde bas kun tu rnam rol zhing*/ /ma rig thibs po'i tshogs sel de las byung ba'i bdud rnams 'jigs byed nyes kun 'joms pa'i dpal/ /bcom ldan dpal chen bla ma mchog dang gnyis su med pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi go 'phang thob bya'i don du de nyid las ni dbang rab blang ba'i cho ga bshad/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing dam tshig dang ldan pa/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu bkod pa bam̐ las sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas dpang po khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin par bskyed pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bskyed la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis gtor ma phul la/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /skyob pa shākya seng ge yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /pham par byas nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /zhes lan gsum gyis mkhyen par gsol nas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /slar yang mchod nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo/ /sa bslang ba'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi dang*/ khor yug thams cad bcag cing*/ lag mthil las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sa'i ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam zhing | oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /yang bcag cing*/ oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod cing*/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam pa ni sa sbyang ba'o/ /de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub bo snyam du blos bzung ba ni sa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dus bzang po la bab pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi byi dor byas pa la mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pas bskor zhing yo byad thams cad bsags nas/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma btang la yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ lha yi rnal 'byor bsgoms la bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o/

/de nas mchod rdzas rnams nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs | stong pa'i ngang las yi ge gsum las byung ba'i mchod rjas dpag tu med pa bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa'i sa chog ltar bya'o/ /de nas ba byung dri bzangs bdud rtsi dang sbyar bas dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar nas g.yas phyogs su khye ma med par byug cing*/ oṃ me ∶di nī (《 zha 》 dī ni )badz+rī bha (《 zha 》 bhā )wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ (《 zha 》+ hūm̐ )gis rdo rje'i sa gzhir byin gyis brlabs/ der skad cig gis srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i dbus dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog cung zad re bkod la/ dbus su skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das yum dang bcas pa dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du ha ha zhes drag tu dgod pa'i ro langs chen po brgyad bskyed nas sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya'o/ /de nas phyi nang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das | gnyis pa chos skyong*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong bcu/ bzhi pa gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po/ lnga pa gzhi'i bdag po rnams dbul lo/ /de nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rig sngags bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri | | de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs | | gang gzhan sngags kyi lha tshogs dang*/ /lha rnams bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /dkyil 'khor 'di la byin rlabs dang*/ /dngos grub dam pa stsol bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum du mkhyen par gsol bas ci dga' ba gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /lha sta gon no/ /de nas mngon par bshams pa'i bum pa gnyis bsangs shing sbyangs nas/

pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis brgyan par bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par mngon byang lnga las bcom ldan 'das yab yum dang*/ las thams cad par yang mngon byang lnga las bgegs mthar byed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje gdengs pa dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa bskyed nas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar du bya ste/ bgegs mthar byed la don yod grub pa'o/ /de la mchod cing bstod nas/ bdag gi snying ga nas spros pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas rgyud bskul nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥdang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs pa bzlas nas mchod cing bstod la dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chur blta'o/ /bum pa sta gon no/ /de nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir tshogs kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa byas nas/ slar yang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ ∶badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha sa (《 zha 》 badz+rod tiṣ+ṭhas/ )sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg la bzhugs su gsol lo/ /sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /nangs par bris pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i mtha' mar mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa'i rgyan nye bar bkram nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa'i bar sta gon ltar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sra zhing brtan pa'i steng du/

bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po bh+rūm̐ gyi mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros snod thams cad gzhal yas khang par bsgyur/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rtsig pa lnga ∶dang ldan (《 zha 》 la sogs 《 lu 》 - dang ldan )pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang zhing*/ dbus khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor thod pa skam po'i ra ba keng rus kyis phub cing*/ g.yang gzhi'i bla re dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi byas pa/ khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du bcom ldan 'das bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin bsgom par bya ste/ 'on kyang yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog nag mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ sgo mtshams brgyad du bhaiṃ gyi yi ge gyur pa las lce brkyang zhing ha ha zhes drag tu dgod cing langs pa'i ro langs chen po brgyad dang*/ grwa rnams su bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa brgyad bsgom mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi skye mched dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ suṃ bhā'i sngags brjod cing*/ rdo rje gsor bas srung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ sta gon gyi lha dam tshig pa la dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān badz+ra bhai ra wā ya/ zhes 'og ma gsum la sbyar la/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ (《 zha 》《 lu 》 hrīḥ )/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /yang rang dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshur spyon tshul spyon 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po gshegs su gsol | | zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ e h+ye hi la sogs pa'i mthar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs spyan drangs/ mchod cing bstod nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ me tog gtor zhing*/ 'dir bzhugs 'dir bzhugs 'jam pa' ི dbyangs / khro bo gshin rje gshed po'i tshogs/ /'jam dpal khro bo mi bzad pa/ /mthu rtsal drag po bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ sngar gyi cho gas bstim pas/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gyur par bsgom/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdams/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya la sogs pa lan gsum brjod do/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o | | de nas mchod yon la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa su la sogs pa yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod la sta gon ltar gtor ma dbul lo/ / mchod pa'o/ /de nas rang dkyil 'khor gyi shar du 'dug nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pas cho ga rnams mdzad la/ las rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i ya mān+ta ka phyag gnyis pas mdzad par bsam zhing*/ rang gi las rnams rang gis dngos su bya'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ ro langs ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /∶zhes pa la sogs pa nas*/(《 lu 》 slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ / mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol | | sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ / )gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/

/zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing*/ u dum bā ra dang man+da ra/ /yongs 'du dang ni ma l+li ka /kar+ṇi ka yi phreng ba 'di/ / legs par nos te bus zungs shig /ces pas me tog gtad pa blang*/ /oṃ āḥ bigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pas bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang*/ bdud rtsi myangs pas byin gyis brlab/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la dga'o/ /zhes lan gdab/ des bu la ci zhig ∶bya'i (《 zha 》 bya / / zhes dris )lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes brjod do/ /de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dmigs pa'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa don dam pa byang chub kyi sems su dmigs nas dngos su rdo rjes gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje gtugs la/ dus 'di nas ni khyod nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas rigs su chud pas na/ /nga yis rdo rje ye shes sbyin/ /de yis sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di nyid ma mthong ba'i | | mdun du smra bar ma byed cig /bag med smras na nyams par 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan gnas par byos/ /zhes gsang bar gdams nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i sgo ba bzhis dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor khrid par bsams nas | na ma sti hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo nā ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi phyag gsum bya/ oṃ badz+ro ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas sgo rnams phye nas shar sgo nas gti mug gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyi byin gyis brlab du gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pas+thā nā ya/ ād+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ād+ma mo hān+ta kṛ ta a dhiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ lho phyogs nas phra ma gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya ād+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ād+ma bi shu nān+ta kṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ nub phyogs nas 'dod chags gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gyis chos ston par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra warta nā ya/ ād+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ād+ma ra gān+ta kṛ ta dharma tsa kra pra warta na ya mā/ zhes pa dang*/ byang phyogs nas phrag dog gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal gy-is phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma naṃ/ ād+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ta ga ta ād+ma i n+ta kṛta karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ de nas 'jam dpal gyi nga rgyal gyis dngos grub thams cad gsol ba'i yid kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta swa bhā wa badz+ra ā tsār+ya pā da naṃ ban+dha naṃ ka ro mi/ sarba sid+dhi/ pra yats+tshan+tu māṃ/ zhes pas phyag lnga bya'o/ /de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa sdom pa gzung ba rnams lan gsum gsum byas nas/ thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung du gzhug pa'i phyir/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes gsungs pa'i phan yon dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas/ gshin rje gshed dpal deng khyod kyi/

/snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /nga yis bstan pa'i gsang ba 'di/ /dam tshig med pa'i mi rnams dang*/ /gang yang gzhan la smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ mna' chu byin nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur/ /'thung shig rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ to da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥzhes phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi/ /gshin rje'i gshed po nga yin gyis

| | nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis skyo ba med par gyis/ /gang yang nga la brnyas par min/ /de bzhin mos pa ma byas na/ /bdud kyis bcom nas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bas dam tshig gnas par gyis/ /zhes rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag par bsam mo/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal gshin rje gshed bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ badz+ra bhai ra wa phyag gnyis par bsgoms pa'i rkang mthil du/ dzhaiṃ me'i rang bzhin snying gar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ snying ga'i nang du 'jam dpal gzhon nu/ mgrin par chu'-i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po has mtshan par bsams nas/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas rkang mthil gyi me spar bas lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ snying ga'i sa dmar por tshig mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ mgo bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang pa'i rlung gis bteg me'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam par char bzhin du bab pas thim par bsam zhing*/ gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyis kyang bdugs la/ hrīḥṣ+t+ṝḥ'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ raḥraḥtsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ aḥha dzhaiṃ/ zhes yang yang gsungs par bsams nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya'o | | de nas bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /gshin rje gshed dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog

/rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa | | dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces gsol ba gdab pa dang*// bden pa'i stobs gsungs nas/ oṃ ma hā pū dza pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor du dbul/ des kyang pra tī gṛ h+na swa mi maṃ satwa ba la oṃ/ zhes gsungs nas spyi bor gnang bar bsam/ de nas mig 'bras gnyis oṃ du bsgoms nas/ gshin rje gshed po ding khyod kyi/ / mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes gsung zhing gdong g.yogs bkrol te | oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ma hā maṇ+ḍa la pra be sha ya phaṭa/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dngos/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gang rtogs zhing khams rnam dag mchog /bla na med pa'i gnas mchog yin/ /rdo rje thugs rje'i rgyun gnas pas | | sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun mi 'chad/ /bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis mthong*/ /phun sum tshogs kun 'dir 'grub 'gyur/ /dngos grub sgrub phyir dam tshig skyongs/ /gsang sngags don la brtson par gyis/ /zhes pas dkyil 'khor bstan pa bltas la dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong bar bsgom pa ni 'jug pa'o/ /yang maṇ+ḍal phul la/ ji ltar rdo rje chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpar dbang bskur ba/ /de bzhin bdag la'ang dbang bskur zhing*/ /bdag la don mchog stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du/ rin po che'i khri chen po pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i spyi bor gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang phyogs thams cad du mchod pa'i sprin bkram pas rang la mchod cing bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i rigs lngas bum pa'i chus khrus gsol/

rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mos mchod par bsam zhing*/ dngos su yang bkra sh-is brjod pa ni sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /de nas dbang thams cad kyi sngon du swa bhā was stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid dhīḥlas 'jam dpal gzhon nu gser gyi mdog can/ ral gri dang pusti ut+pal dang bcas pa 'dzin par bskyed do/ /de'i thugs ka dang rnam rgyal gyi bum par ya las rdo rje yas mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyar ba'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ ye shes pa bstim/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur bsam/ dbang gi lha rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis ji ltar bltams pa ∶la sogs pa dang (《 lu 》 tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ / lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ )/oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ∶ti s+t+waṃ(《 zha 》《 lu 》 ta twam̐ swa )/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ nang gi dbang gi don du/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /thugs kyi rdo rjer mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas | bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal nas 'od sngon po byung*/ rang gi lus thams cad yongs su sbyangs/ 'od kyi lam nas zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ thig le'i rnam pas yum gyi mkhar babs pa/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed du bskyed/ sku gsum thugs byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang de nyid kyi rnam pas stim/ bha ga nas phyir 'phros nas rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la/

mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ tshul 'di dag 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /yang bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng dang | dbu rgyan ma las rin po che mas mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi (《 lu 》 dngos )cod pan dbang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid rab bsgrub phyir/ /cod pan mchog gi dbang bskur bas/ / 'khor los sgyur rgyal mgon dbang bskur/ oṃ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ hūm̐/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis cod pan dang*/ chus kyang dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan yon tan rdo rje 'dzin ∶la sogs pa dang (《 lu 》 rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs su/ )/yon tan rdo rje bdag mdzod cig/ ces gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar phra ma gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /yang bdag gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng dang*/ rdo rje me las pad+ma mes mtshan pa las 'od dpag med yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs/ dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje mchog gi dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa yā mis rdo rje dang*/

bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan/ chos kyi gsung lam dpal dang ldan/ /∶la sogs pa nas/(《 lu 》 rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su// ) gsung gi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /yang rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng dang*/ dril bu da las ral gri das mtshan pa las ∶phrag dog gshin rje gshed (《 zha 》《 lu 》 don yod grub pa )yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs | dbang rdzas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bsam/ sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ chos kyi dril bu bla med don/ /stong nyid ye shes sgra sgrogs pa'i/ /thams cad stong nyid don ston pa'i/ /dril bu'i dbang bskur bla na med/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shap+da pa ta l+ye dharma dhā tu a bhi ṣe ka ta shri ye sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dril bu dang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan phrin las rdo rje 'dzin | | ∶la sogs pa nas/(《 lu 》 mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byi gyis brlabs su/ / )phrin las rdo rje bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar phrag dog gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur | bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /yang rang gi snying ga'i nyi ma'i steng du/ k+ṣe las 'khor lo k+ṣes mtshan pa las 'od spro bsdu bya zhing yongs su gyur pas rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs

| sngar bzhin gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i ming*/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/(《 zha 》+ sangs rgyas kun tu rab grub phyir | | rdo rje'i ming 'di khyod kyis zungs/ )/oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta shri ye sa ma ya hūm̐/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes ming dang chus kyang dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ dpal ldan rdo rje'i sku 'chang ba/ /∶la sogs pa dang (《 lu 》 rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /ding bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ / )sku yi rdo rjer bdag mdzod cig gis gsol ba gdab/ yum gyi bha gar gti mug gshin rje gshed du gyur/ ye shes pa bstim/ rang gi gnas su 'khod pa la mchod nas/ ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs ky-i phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o | | de nas rang nyid rigs lnga ka'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' phyag gnyis pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang gnyis su med par bsgoms pa la dbang gi lhas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin las grub pa'i rdo rje gnang ba/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /rdo rje sems pa'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ e ṣa dha ra yā mi/ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing (《 lu 》+ rdo rje gnang ba )snying gar bzung nas/ snying ga'i nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te/ slob ma'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kye ho khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ / bdag la rang dang gzhan gyi don/ /rdzogs phyir rdo rje slob dpon dbang*/

/snying rje'i gter gyis stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang nyid 'jam dpal du bsgoms pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar bskyed/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyi dngos/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsum du bdag sgrubs shig /ces gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi bha gar babs pa'i rdo rje 'chang sngon po yum dang bcas par gyur/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /skye mched kyang byin gyis brlabs nas dbang bskur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ ro gcig par byas te bha ga nas 'phros nas dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gnas pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /la sogs pa sngags dang bcas pas rdo rje gnang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing thugs kyi dam tshig dang*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ / shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces pas g.yon par dril bu gnang nas/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ

zhes dril bu'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing gsung gi dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che | | zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ / slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes rjes su gnang ba byin nas yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas pa la/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*/ /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zungs/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis | | de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig rgyas par gsungs nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis (《 zha 》+ oṃ )su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing me tog gi char phab nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas gzhal yas khang pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin la/ dur khrod ni lus dang 'jig rten gyi chos rnam par dag pa yin zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'o/ /zhes dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*/ lha rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo'o/ /zhes lha'i de kho na nyid dang*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang gsung dang thugs la tshang ngo*/ /zhes slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid gsung bar bsam mo/ /de kho na nyid do/ /de nas rang nyid zhi ba'i sku las khro bo'i skur yongs su rdzogs par bskyed/

sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlab/ dbang mdor bsdus te bskur nas ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas me tog phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rang gi zhal du zhugs pa snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar bkod par bsam zhing*/ gsung gi rjes su gnang bar bsams la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying lan gsum gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bzlas nas/ me tog phul bas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs nas phreng ba spyi bor bzhag pa ni sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba'o/ /sdug pa'i gdong du bltas nas ni/ /bltas par gyur pa'i bde ba de/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur

| | bud med kun gyis yongs bskor la/ /kun nas rtses pa'i bde ba de// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /dge 'am yang na mi dge ba'i/ /las rnams byas pa gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni/ /skad cig gis ni gzi can 'gyur/ /zhes mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ mchog gi dngos grub thams cad ni/ /brtul zhugs mchog gis bsgrub par bya*/ /de phyir gshin rje 'joms pa yi/ /brtul zhugs rnam pa kun tu spyod/ /phal cher dngos grub mchog rnams ni/ /brtul zhugs med pas mi 'grub pas/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs 'di/ /legs spyod mchog gi ∶dngos su (《 lu 》 brtul zhugs )bsgrubs/ /zhes pas brtul zhugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ ji ltar dbang bskur la sogs pas/ /sangs rgyas la sogs thob pa bzhin/ /byang chub spyod tshogs gzhan dag dang*/ /'dul sogs dge bas de lta min/ /de bas dam tshig bus srung shig /rtag tu sdom pa yang bsrung ngo*/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' ste/ /de las gzhan pa'i dam tshig srungs/ /dkon mchog gnod pa gsad bya zhing*/ /bud med kun la spyad par bya/ /pha rol nor ni blang bya zhing*/ /rtag tu brdzun gyi tshig kyang smros/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las gang gsungs pa | | de yang cho ga bzhin du srungs/ /zhes pa dam tshig gi rjes gnang dang*/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun tu dri med gang bar gyis/ /zhes dung dang*/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje gnang nas | zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba ste/

/nad la sogs pa zhi bar bya/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa ste/ /rin chen char sprin rab bskor bya/ /rjes su chags pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dbang gi las ni yang dag sgrubs/ /gsad pa'i sems kyis drag po ste/ /me yi char sprin dbab par bya/ /zhes pas phrin las bzhi'i rjes gnang dang*/ kham̐ las bskyed pa'i ye shes kyi ral gri byin nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /las kyi ral gri gcig pu mchog /bdud las rgyal bar bya phyir zungs/ /oṃ badz+ra khaḍ+ga hūm̐/ zhes pas khyad par du drag po'i phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang*/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ /mchil lham de bzhin ri lu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni | | de ni ci dgar bsgrub par gyis/ /zhes pas dngos grub kyi rjes gnang mdzad par bsam pa ni rjes su gnang ba'o/ /de nas bla mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor gtugs nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ / gshin rje gshed dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum du bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes lung bstan par bsam mo/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ / sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/

/sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas nas sangs rgyas la | | phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*/ khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ /ces pas dbugs dbyung*/ de ring khyod bdag legs par rnyed/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs su skyes/ / sems nyid rin chen 'byung ba'i gter/ /phun sum tshogs pa nye bar gnas/ / gsang sngags mnyam med sems las grub/ /zag med bde ba'i dkyil 'khor che | | mthong ba'am ni zhugs gyur pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ / byang chub sems mchog rmad byung rnyed/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gnas mchog / bdud bzhi 'joms shing sdug bsngal gyi/ /skye rga na 'chi 'jig par byed/ /srid pa ngo bo nyid dag pas*/ /phyag na rdo rjer da gyur to/ /zhes gzengs bstod do/ / phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /bum pa'i dbang ∶thob(《 lu 》 dbang ngo*/ / ) de nas bla ma longs skur dmigs pa la gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcing zhing 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs | bcom ldan 'das yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs thugs kar 'od du zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas phyung nas/ btung ba rin chen dam pa 'di/ /rdo rje'i lus ni rab sgrub byed// bu khyod de ltar shes gyis la/ /yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung shig /ces gsungs nas | lce thog du gnang ba a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod de/ mid pas lus thams cad gang zhing*/

ngag gi dri ma dag nas/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed du gyur par bsgoms la/ gdong g.yogs phye ste bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo | | de nas bla ma chos skur dmigs pa la/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ 'bru gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs | rang dpal chen por dmigs pa la/ /gzungs ma 'di ni yid 'ong ma | | bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs/ /'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /zhes pas/ rdo rje ro langs ma gnang ba dang*/ des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*/ /bha ga'i pad+mor ∶'o byed pa(《 lu 》 tsum+bha na )/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du | ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni/ /lha mo bdag ni spro gyur to/ /zhes lan gdab pa dang*/ lha mo des bha ga'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ /e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di | | bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten pa/ /de yi mdun na nga gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ / twaṃ bhañdza mo k+ṣa ho/ zhes brjod nas pang du byon pa dang*/ slar yang gnyis ka'i sku gsal btab/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs/ gnas lngar yi ge 'bru lnga dgod | lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam pa'i 'du shes kyis snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas par bsams la sems gzung ngo*/

/de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes dran par bya'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs pa la dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bzhi pa yang ni stsal du gsol | | zhes gsol ba gdab/ gdong g.yogs bcing*/ byin gyis brlab/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pa la/ brtan g.yo'i dngos po ma lus pa | | bsgom par bya ba'i dus nyid na/ /blos ni yongs su mi bsgom ste/ /kun gyi mtshan nyid mi shes na/ /de kho na nyid bsgom min te/ /dngos po thams cad yongs shes na/ /de ni bsgom par yongs su bsgrags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don spros bral gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/∶bsam gyis mi khyab pa (《 lu 》 rdo rje rba rlabs )bsgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas snyam du bsam mo/ / dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas lus dang longs spyod thams cad yon du phul la/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*/ /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang*/ len pa po dang*/ len pa'i tshul gsum ka rang bzhin med par sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i phyir
