| tshogs kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod cing bstod de/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bsngau ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blau yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang brjod de/ dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo/ / ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur ba'i phyir | brtan par bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo dang bcas pas gtang ste/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum bsrungs nas las kyi rjes bsdus te/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel pa'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar rtag tu dbang lam du byas pas gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal nas/ tshe dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ srid pa thams cad du rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i go 'phang mchog thob ste/ sa dang lam thams cad bde blag du bgrod nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs gzhon nu chos la thugs gsal dpal 'byor phun tshogs lcags mtshan 'chang bas bskur ba'i ngor/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung 'bras bu nyer 'byin cho ga'i rim pa 'phags pas sbyar las dge ba gang*/ /nye bar bskrun pa dge ba kun dang rnam par 'dres nas sems can kun la rab khyab ste/

/thams cad thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid gyur cig /dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing*/ dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba chu mo bya'i lo ston zla ra ba'i tshes (《 zha 》 - tshes )nyi shu dgu la shing kun du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya'o || || ༄༅/ /dpal chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gnyis med ye shes rdo rje'i mes/ /srid pa'i nyes tshogs tshang tshing rnam bsreg pa/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i me la phyag 'tshal nas | | sbyin sreg cho ga'i rim pa bdag gis bshad/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shing*/ bsnyen pa sngon du song la ting nge 'dzin brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ gnas skabs kyi don bsgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sa yongs su sbyangs pa'i sar las dang mthun pa'i thab tu bud shing brtsigs pa dang*/ yo byad mngon par 'dus byas nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed gtor mas mchod pa'i bar byas nas/ thab kyi drung du zhi ba la shar | rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub/ drag po la lhor phyogs te 'dug la/ yang snying brjod cing nang mchod kyis thab dang yo byad bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs | stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las zhi ba la thab khung dkar po zlum po/ mu ran la rdo rje phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi ser po mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ dbang la zla gam dmar po mu ran la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ drag po la gru gsum nag po mu ran la rdo rje gdengs pas bskor ba rgya'i phyed kyi dpangs dang ldan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las dang mthun pa'i bud shing gi rtsig pas yongs su gang ba bskyed nas/

slar yang hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo/ /'jam po gsum la bsreg rdzas g.yas dang | mchod rdzas g.yon dang*/ drag po la bsreg rdzas g.yon dang*/ mchod rdzas g.yas su bsham pa/ re re'ang oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rdzas so so dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ 'jam po gsum la g.yas skor dang*/ drag po la g.yon skor gyis lan gsum bskor te/ shar lho nas me spar la/ yang blugs gzar gyis lan gsum blugs shing*/ badz+ra dz+wa la'i sngags brjod la me gso'o/ /de nas me de bsangs shing sbyangs la/ stong ba'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la gnas pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dbyu gu gsum pa dang gun+dhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ tshangs pa'i skud pa 'chang ba/ las dang mthun pa'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa/ bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du ∶oṃ āḥhūm̐ (《

lu 》 'bru gsum )bkod nas | rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis/ shar lho'i mtshams nas me lha spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong 'byung po'i bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can smin mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang*/ dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgyas g.yab pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā dha kaḥ kā ru ṇ+ya kṛ ta satwa ar+tha na/ a smin+san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas/ thab kyi shar lhor spyan drangs la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa phyi dang*/ nang bdud rtsis mchod nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa bam̐ | badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa la bstim mo/ /yang dbang gi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ zhi ba la rnam par snang mdzad/ rgyas pa la rin chen 'byung ldan/ dbang la 'od dpag med | drag po la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i ku sha brgyad dag byed du 'bul zhing*/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge | dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yis kyang dag byed yin// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /ces brjod nas/ phyogs mtshams nas 'bul la | | de nas de'i zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas mar gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye ā di pyā di pya bi shud+dhe ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya/ zhes pa'i mthar

| zhi ba la sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rgyas pa la tshe dang*/ bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ drag po la che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod cing dgang blugs gsum dbul lo/ /de nas oṃ ag+na ye/ zhes pa'i mthar | ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa phyi'i mchod pa dang nang gi mchod pa phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing*/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod nas/ zhu ba'i rdzas zhal dang*/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag dang*/ yam shing 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la phul bar bsam zhing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de ye swā hās zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+tā ya swā hās 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so ba/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūr ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis dbul te mtha' rten gyi tshig rnams ni sngar bshad pa bzhin no// rim pa ni mar gyi rjes su zhi ba la til/ rgyas pa la zas mchog dbang la me tog gam/ 'bras bu dmar po/ drag po la khrag dang dug dang ske tshe bsres pa'o// me tog dmar po la/ oṃ ag+na ye ∶wa shaṃ (《 lu 》 paṣ+tiṃ )ku ru ho/ khrag la sogs pa la oṃ ag+na ye mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /'jam po gsum la lag pa g.yas pa dang*/ drag po la g.yon pas dbul lo/ /bsreg rdzas phul ba'i mthar/ mchod cing bstod de mar blugs gzar gang blugs nas/

oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /de nas 'bar ba'i dbus su srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar/ sgrub thabs bzhin bskyed de | rigs bdag ni rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par blta'o/ /lha'i sku mdog ni las so so'i dbang gis mi 'gyur bas/ mdangs dang 'od ni zhi ba la dkar po/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po/ so so'i nyams dang cha lugs dang ldan zhing de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa'i pho nya rnams kyis las so so'i mdzad par bsgom mo/ /de nas/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i ā di pyā di pya la sogs pa'i sngags kyis byon zan dgang blugs gsum phul nas tshigs su bcad pa sngags dang bcas pas phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ nang bdud rtsi dang*/ yid las byung ba dang*/ bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas | gtor ma phul la bsreg rdzas rnams sngar bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te/ khyad par ni 'di'i dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi sha bdud rtsi ri lu dang sbyar te phye mar byas pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab pa byas pa yin no/ /bsreg rdzas de dag gang la bsnyen pa song ba'i sngags kyis dbul lo/ /zhi ba la brgya/ rgyas pa la brgya rtsa brgyad/ dbang la nyi shu rtsa lnga/ drag po la drug cu tham pas dbul ba'i thog ma dang tha mar spel tshig sbyar ro/ khyad par gyi rdzas la ni shin tu mang bar phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba satwa dā ma ka ma hā bhū ta pa ti i daṃ bhu dza grih+nā pa ya gri h+nā pa ya'i rjes su so so'i spel tshig dang bcas pa ci rigs pas dbul lo/ /me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang*/ mar ni me'i tshod dang sbyar te dbul lo/ /mthar lha'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas mar dgang blugs gsum dbul lo/ /slar yang mchod cing bstod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/

/de nas/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blau yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod | | ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don du kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya mān+ta ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa | a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga bān/ sarba ta thā ga ta ya mān+ta ka ma me muñtsa | badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa muḥzhes ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ thab kyi dbus nas thal ba'i rdul cung zad blangs nas dpral bar bskus pas dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /∶'jig rten las (《 lu 》 de dag la rten nas )'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o/ /de nas yang mar blugs gzar gang thab kyi dbus su blugs nas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ 'jig rtain pa'i me lha gsal bar dmigs pa la/ snga ma bzhin mchod cing bstod nas/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs par phul ba'i mthar/ spel tshig dang bcas pa'i mar dgang blugs gsum dbul lo/ /yang mchod cing bstod la gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ ag+na ye/ na mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo la sogs pa lan gsum gyis phul nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab la/ bdag las dang po pa'i gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ sngags ma dag pa dang*/ cho ga 'khrul ba dang*/ yo byad dman par gyur pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol | zhes bzod par gsol nas/ dbyu gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya las bkyed pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ swaḥ.ar+thañtsai wa pa rār+thañtse/

sā dhi twaṃ gats+tsha ha bya bhu ∶ka ā ga mi ṣ+wa pi ya thā kā le/ sarba sid+dhiṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me(《 lu 》 ku )/ zhes pas me lha'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ snga ma bzhin dam tshig pa bdag la bstim nas/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la rtsa ru'i bza' ba la longs spyad do/ /de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba la sogs pa rjes kyi bya ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par byas nas | me mnal ba dang thal ba chu bor dor ro/ /de lta bu cho ga yan lag phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin sreg byas pas bzlas pa'i lhag chad kyi nyes pa dag par 'gyur zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ rang gi lhag pa'i lha mnyes nas/ thun mong dang mchog gi dngos grub ∶'grub par (《 zha 》 stsol bar ) 'gyur ba nyid de/ yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las/ sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims/ /tshims nas dngos grub rab tu ster/ /gang zhig sngags kyi lha chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /de ltar las kyi mchog rab sbyin sreg gi /cho ga rgyal bus bskul nas bdag gis sbyar/ /dge bas skul bar byed pas gtso byas pa'i/ /'gro kun 'jam pa'i rdo rje 'gyur bar shog /shing pho khyi'i lo ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin zhag la (《 zha 》+ 'phags pas )un chang hu zhes bya ba'i pho brang du ྄a tsa ra zhes bya bas yi ge'i 'du byed mngon par bsgrub te sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam rol bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'jam dpal zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi la zhi dang khro bo la/ khro sogs rnam 'phrul bye ba brgyas/ /gdul bya 'dul ba'i don mdzad pa/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyis bdag skyongs shig /de yi go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /de nyid la ni phyag 'tshal nas/ /de mnyes byed pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /de yi rjes bzung gsung bzhin bshad/

/de la dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang dang rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'di nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngaun du song nas/ rang 'jam dpal du mos pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ 'jam dpal khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ de la phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥhās mchod yon/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis 'thor 'thung*/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pi ni dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ has me tog oṃ hri ha ha he hes bdug spos/ oṃ dīp+ta lo tsa na wi kṛ tā na na ma hā aṭ+ṭa ha sa na de ni dīp+ta dīp+ta ya swā hās mar me/ oṃ wi kṛ tā na na duṣ+ta satwa da ma ka ga gas dri/ oṃ kā la rū pa sarba satwa da ma ka nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas te/ phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ bde ba chen pos mchod nas/ sdig pa rnams ni bshags par bgyi/ /skyes shing byung ba rnams ni bsal/ /mi byed par yang spyan sngar brjod/ /de bzhin bsod nams rjes yi rangs/ /bdag gis bde 'gror yongs su bsngo/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis bsgral/ /byang chub gnas la dgod par bgyi/ / byang chub sems ni yang dag bskyed/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom | oṃ dza ya dza ya/ su dza ya bi shwa rū pa dha ri/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/∶sarba daṃṣ+t+rī t+ya te (《 zha 》 sas+tha kṛ taṃ te na )/ ta thā ga te nāṃ/ sarba shud+dha shrī bi dza ya ma ma kar+yaṃ ku ru swā hās gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas srung ba'i 'khor lo bskyed pa'i nang du/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog lta bu'i steng du/ āḥlas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dhīḥlas rang nyid 'jam dpal dmar ser/

phyag g.yas pa ral gri/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ de'i thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i 'od kyis bdag nyid zhu nas gdan nyi ma la thim/ de las 'od kyi rtser 'jam dpal bzhugs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ gdug pa can thams cad btul zhing dag pa dang*/ sems can smin par byas/ slar 'dus nyi ma la thim/ yang 'od 'phros | sangs rgyas/ rig ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ nyi ma la thim pas nyi ma de nyid dpag tshad 'bum gyi tshad tsam du gyur pa'i dbus su dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i gzhi | shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lha snam dmar po/ nang gi grwa bzhir bum pa brgyad dang*/ ka pā la bzhis mtshan pa/ dbus le tshe dgu pa lha'i gnas bzhi bcu zhe dgur/ rlung dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan bsam/ de'i steng du dbus nas rim pa bzhin/ dhīḥ.om̐ ām̐ dz+rīṃ kham̐ sam̐ ram̐ dham̐ kam̐ le tshe dgu la'o/ / lha snam la shar nas rim pa bzhin/ ti ྃ(《 zha 》 bam̐ )kham̐ ∶maiṃ dz+nyam̐ (《 zha 》《 lu 》 meṃ nyam̐ )wam̐ tsam̐ dz+nyām̐/ lho nas rim pas/ bam̐ (《 zha 》 bi ྃ )yam̐ mum̐ tī ྃhe (《 zha 》 - he ྃ )dham̐ ram̐ (《 zha 》 《 lu 》+ ti ྃ )dzām̐/ nub nas rim pas/ bām̐ (《 zha 》 bham̐ )sam̐ rām̐ rām̐ sām̐ ram̐ (《 zha 》 sam̐ )sum̐ bam̐/ byang nas rim pa bzhin/ ke ྃham̐ gam̐ dz+nyām̐ (《 zha 》+ dzam̐ )sam̐ mam̐ am̐ rnams dang*/ shar nas sgo bzhir/ am̐ pām̐ ∶s+pham̐ gham̐(《 zha 》 yam̐ gam̐ )/ me nas grwa bzhir/ sum̐ um̐ hūm̐ ām̐ rnams bsam | de dag las 'od zer phar 'phros/ rang rang gi rigs kyi sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas lhar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid 'jam dpal nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog lta bu/ phyag g.yas ral gri/ g.yon pu sti dang bcas pa'i ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ shar nas gti mug rdo rje/ phra ma rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje | phrag dog rdo rje/ shar lho nas sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin chen rdo rje ma/

chos kyi rdo rje ma/ las kyi rdo rje ma/ shar du rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje ral gri/ byams pa/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi sku/ ngag gi dbang phyug zla 'od ye shes mtsho'o/ / lhor rdo rje sna tshogs/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje srung ba/ rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje rgyu/ dra ba can gyi 'od do/ /nub tu rdo rje smra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa' | rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje nyi 'od/ rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /byang du rdo rje dpal/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ spos kyi glang po/ ye shes tog 'gro ba 'dul ba/ rgya mtsho'i blo gros/ blo gros mi zad pa/ bdud rtsi 'od do/ /shar sgo la sogs par/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu'o/ /shar lho nas rdo rje gnod mdzes/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'o/ /shar dang shar lho ba thams cad sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lho dang lho nub ba ser po/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub dang nub byang ba dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa

| byang dang byang shar ba ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa thams cad kyis thugs kar pu sti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ nyi ma'i nyams can du bltas pa de la dmigs pa gtad de yid gzung ngo*/ /de nas sems can gyi khams rab 'byams la bltas pas gshin rje la sogs pa gdug pa can rnams zhi bas mi 'dul zhing khro bos 'dul ba'i phyir/ shin tu gdug pa drag po dag /zhi ba nye bar mi sbyar te/ /'di mkhyen rdo rje can nyid ni/ khro bor de bzhin gshegs skur gyur | | hūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re bsam/ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zer spyan drangs pa nyi ma la thim/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'od gsal la thim pas/ lha rnams nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re rer gyur/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas | sngags kyi tshogs spyan drangs/ nyi ma rnams la thim zhing*/ chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar nyi ma rnams kyi steng du sa bon du gyur pa ni/ sngags kyi rim pa ni/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṣ+t+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na/ zhes pa dang*/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi tshogs spyan drangs/ yi ge rnams la thim pas phyag mtshan du gyur pa ni/ sngar gyi rim pas/ gri gug mgo lag pa/ rgyu ma/ rkang pa/ thod pa/ thod tshal/ ro ras/ gsal shing gis phug pa'i skyes bu/ gri gug mtshon rtse gcig pa/ gtun shing*/ chu gri rtse gcig rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ ma he/ wa/ dgra sta/ mda'/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo/ zhags pa | phag bong bu/ rdo rje rtse lnga/

rnge'u chung*/ phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ rnga mo | khyi/ sdigs 'dzub/ 'phan lce gsum pa/ glang chen ko rlon/ tho ba/ mdung*/ me thab/ lug ce sbyang*/ bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ bya rog ne tso/ khyung*/ khwa/ ri skegs/ bzhad rnams su gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ phyag mtshan so so la thim pas lhar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'o/ /'khor rnams ni/ shar gyi re mig nas brtsams nas rim pas/ rdo rje mgo rdo rje lag pa/ rdo rje rgyu ma/ rdo rje rkang pa/ rdo rje thod pa | rdo rje thod tshal/ rdo rje ro ras/ rdo rje gsal shing ngo*/ /lha snam gyi lha rnams ni rim pas/ rdo rje gri gug rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje gtun shing*/ rdo rje chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje ma he/ rdo rje wa'o/ /rdo rje dgra sta/ rdo rje mda'/ rdo rje dbyug pa/ rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rdo rje 'khor lo/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje phag rdo rje bong bu'o/ /rdo rje rdo rje/ rdo rje rngai+e'u chung*/ rdo rje phub/ rdo rje gzhu/ rdo rje dril bu/ rdo rje rlung ras/ rdo rje rnga mo/ rdo rje khyi'o/ /rdo rje sdigs mdzub/ rdo rje 'phan | rdo rje glang lpags/ rdo rje tho ba/ rdo rje mdung thung*/ rdo rje me thab/ rdo rje lug rdo rje spyang ki'o/ /rdo rje bya rgod/ rdo rje 'ug pa/ rdo rje bya rog rdo rje ne tso'o// rdo rje khyung*/ rdo rje khra/ rdo rje'i ri skegs/ rdo rje bzhad do/ /de rnams thams cad sku mdog nag po ma he'i gdong pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ lid+ga gyen du rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pas ma he mnan pa/

nyams dang rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon dgod/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ las sa'i snying po dkar | rna bar dz+rīṃ las phyag na rdo rje sngau/ snar kham̐ las nam mkha'i snying po ser/ khar gam̐ las 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar/ dpral bar kaṃ las sgrib pa rnam sel ljang*/ snying gar sam̐ las kun tu bzang po sngon po dang*/ spyi bor om̐ las sku rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sngon po rnams bskyed la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas sa bon gyi yi ge rnams las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ de la snga ma bzhin mchod/ rang gi snying ga nas sgo ba bzhi spros pas/ ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gṛdh+ra badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra u lū ka badz+ra pā sh+yi hrīḥ oṃ kā ka badz+ra s+phoṭa baṃ/ oṃ shu ka badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod do | | yang 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed kyi rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ snga ma bzhin mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ gsol zhes )gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa | | sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin | | oṃ badz+ra u da ka abhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i glu dbyangs dang bkra shis brjod/ bgegs bskrad mchod pas mchod/ dbang gi chu rgyun des lha thams cad kyi lus gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag

dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo phyag gnyis pas dbur brgyan par bsams nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la bstim mo/ /de nas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi myangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams tshim par bsams nas/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam zhing*/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po 'di/ / dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin no/ /'dod pa lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho rol du gsol/ /gnas par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ /dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol bar mdzod/ /reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ / mi g.yo bzhin du rol du gsol/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ / ces pas mchod nas/(《 zha 》《 lu 》+ lha mo de dag nyid kyis/ )mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /la sogs pas bstod nas/ lha mo de dag dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi ba spu'i bu gar thim par bsgoms la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o | | sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyi rang gi sgrib pa gnyis sbyangs | tshogs gnyis spel/ phrin las bzhi bsgrubs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags | snying po/ nye ba'i snying po rnams bzla'o/ /'khor rnams kyi sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ oṃ badz+ra shi raḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hasta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra an+t+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pā da hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra ka pā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsa sha ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sh+ma shā ni ka ra pa tā ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shū la bi na pu ru ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bhiṇ+ḍa pā ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ∶mu sa (《 zha 》 gu sha )la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ts+tshu ri ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kar+ṇā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hir+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shriṃ ga la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ku tha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bā ra ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra garda bā hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa ma ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pha la ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dha nuḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra wa ta pa ḍa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ta hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ badz+ra shwa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tardza ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tri pa daṃ ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra nā ga tsarma hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅka ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kun+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ag+ni kuṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra me ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shwa na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra gṛ dh+ra hūm̐ phaṭa | oṃ badz+ra u lū ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra shu ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra se na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā sha ku ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsang sngags rnams ci nus pa bzla'o/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas mngon par bshams pa'i gtor ma/ yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi dbus su yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ sgyed pu'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa'i nang du/ shar du go las ba lang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha

dbus su na las mi'i sha shar lhor bi las dri chen/ lho nub tu mu las dri chu/ nub byang du ma (《 zha 》《 lu 》 ra )las rak+ta/ byang shar du shu las byang sems/ de rnams kyi steng du/ dbus nas rim pas/ yak+ṣe ma me da/ bsams nas/ de las 'od 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams bzhu/ yig 'bru lnga las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ yig 'bru dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du thim zhing*/ 'dres pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo skad cig la dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ∶dpag tu med pas (《 zha 》《 lu 》 thams cad kyi )bskor ba spyan drangs la mdun bskyed la bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad bkug pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu gnas par bsgoms la/ sngags gsum gyi mthar | i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba bigh+nān sha trūn mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam bdun gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang*/ oṃ oṃ bhu tsa ra naṃ ya satwa la tsa ra naṃ man kha tsa ra ni/ ta pūrba adhi gha naṃ/ ka da k+ṣi ni/ a di gha naṃ/ hūm̐ pash+tsi ma a dhi ga ni phaṭa/ ut+ta ra a dhi gha naṃ/ oṃ i hrīḥ yaṣ+t+riḥ yaṣ+t+riḥ ba wi ku kṛ i ta a/ na ni nā ba hūm̐ bho/ phaṭa sarba bhū te bh+ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa (《 zha 》+ gsum mam )bdun gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phul la/ mchod cing bstod nas phrin las bcol la dngos grub gnang bar bsams nas/ bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol te gtor ma gtong ngo*/(《

zha 》《 lu 》+ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ )/de nas gtor ma ltar kha zas (《 lu 》+ gtor ma ltar )byin gyis brlabs la | rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du mos te/ lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na/ snying gar lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i rigs bdag tu bla ma bzhugs pa dang*/ lto bar 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs ma lus pa dmigs shing*/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis/ bza' btung rnams bsreg rdzas kyi tshul du dmigs la/(《 zha 》《 lu 》+ kha )me'i thab khung du phul bas/ 'khor 'das kyi lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing*/ sdang zhen med par longs spyad do/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe | rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lo mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ gzhal yas khang lam gyi chos rnam par dag pa/ lha rnams 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang*/ yon tan dang phrin las rnam par dag pa/ bcom ldan 'das ni 'dod chags dag cing 'dul ba'i phyir/ lid+ga gyen du rgyas pa/ zhe sdang dag cing 'dul bas (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ khro bo chen po'i sku/ gti mug dag cing 'dul bas kha dog dang dbyibs dang mtshan mas brjid pa/ bdud rtsi lnga dang 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rnam par dag pas zhal dgu/ kā li rnam par dag pas )phyag sum cu so bzhi/ ā li rnam par dag pas zhabs bcu drug sangs rgyas kyi yon tan (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ yongs su )rdzogs pas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ phrin las sna tshogs pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas phyag mtshan dang gdan sna tshogs pa sprul pa du ma 'phro ba'o/ /zhes dag pa dran par byas nas/ gzhal yas khang dang 'khor rnams rang la bsdus la/ bdag dang snang ba lha/ brjod pa dang grag pa sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs te/ snang ba sna tshogs su snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ rang bzhin stong pa chos kyi sku/

ngo bo zung 'jug longs skur dmigs te/ sdang ba dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ dogs pa med pa'i tshul gyis ci bde bar spyad do/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas nub mo gnyid log pa'i tshe/ lha rnams bsdus nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal lo/ / gnyid sad pa'i tshe/(《 zha 》《 lu 》+ chu las )chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs la ldang ngo*/ khrus ni dbang gi skabs dang 'dra ba nyid do/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ ji ltar dbugs ni me long la/ /rang nyid nges par thim pa ltar | | de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mtha'/ /yang dang yang du mngon du byed// ces 'byung ba ltar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyi spro bsdus/ snod bcud dang dkyil 'khor rnams gsal ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ rim gyis bsdu ba byas nas mthar stong pa nyid la zhugs te/ 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas rdzogs rim las langs nas/ bskyed rim la 'jug pa'i tshe/ ji ltar chu klung dwangs pa las/ /nya dag yongs su 'phar ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong pa las/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba bzhengs par mdzad/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis skad cig gis lha'i sku sgyu 'phrul dra bar bzhengs nas/ rnal 'byor gzhan la 'jug par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa'o/ /las tshogs kyi cho ga zhib mo ni gzhung gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma

| slob dpon la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra ∶che ba(《 zha 》 - che ba )/ a mo gha badz+ra chung ba/ bla ma skyo 'od 'byung*/ rtsang yang dag 'bar/ yang dag rdo rje/ rngog rdo rje rgyal po/ gze pa don grub ye shes/ khams ston shākya rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum rnams so/ /zhi ba'i mthar thug 'jam pa'i dpal yin te/ /drag po'i mthar thug rdo rje 'jigs byed dpal/ /gnyis ka'ang zung 'jug bde ba'i mthar thug dpal/ /chos tshul 'di na ི thabs kyi mthar thug yin/ /de 'dra bdag gis rnam par bsdebs pa yi/ /dge bas zung 'jug chen po'i dpal thob nas// srid zhir gnas pa'i 'byung po ma lus pa/ /zung 'jug bde ba'i dpal la 'god par shog /rdo rje 'jigs byed rtog pa ni/ /sum brgya pa ste 'jam dpal gyi/ / rgyud las dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /cung zad tsam zhig phyung nas btus/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshul gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa rgyas pa las/ sgrub pa'i thabs rgya cher gsungs pa'i don/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa'i gzhung nyams su blang ba'i tshul (《 zha 》《 lu 》+ go )bde bar bkrol ba 'di ni/ sngags 'chang ba'i dge slong 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ mdo khams kyi sa'i cha tsom mdo gnas gsar zhes bya bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zi ston gzhon nu dpal lo || || chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod gsum pa/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 100PAGE 99 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9 EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
